# Data subject request procedure

## Request types

A person may ask for access, erasure or rectification of their data.

## Identity check

Staff verify the identity of the requester before any data is released.

## Response time

We answer within one month of receiving the request in writing.

## Handling steps

Support logs the request, the privacy lead decides, support replies.

## Record keeping

Each request is logged in the request tracker with its outcome.
